text:
alex (infra): FYI, we're getting a burst of automated pager retries from incident-bot -> PagerDuty. ~150 retry attempts in the last 3m, a bunch were suppressed by PD dedupe/rate limits. Some on-callers never got a page. Investigating customer impact now.
incident-bot: ERROR notify-proxy responded 502 for /v2/pages (attempt 3) request_id=xyz12345
jamal (oncall): @alex @maria putting myself on it. Can you suspend the bot retries so we stop flooding PD?
maria (sre): I'm going to set incident-bot to maintenance mode and reduce retry loop. @jamal can you confirm manual paging flow for affected teams?
alex (infra): Suspend call made: POST /internal/actions/suspend?target=incident-bot&reason=retry-flood :done: Also reverting the notifier commit that rolled header signing change (PR #1987).
notify-proxy: WARN header_size_exceeded for route /pager — trimmed headers: x-pd-signature,x-routing-id
lisa (support): Customer impact: Two paying customers (accts ACME, BrightPlan) reported they didn't receive high-priority alerts in the window. They've opened high-priority support cases. Escalating to AE.
jamal (oncall): Manual page sequence executed -> `./tools/manual_page --team infra --urgency high` Confirmed audible phone page received by oncall.
maria (sre): Metrics: pager queue spike at T+00:02, retry count peaked ~150, delivery success % dropped from 99.9% to 88% during window. PD suppression logs show dedupe window fired.
alex (infra): Root cause hypothesis: header signing change increased header length -> nginx/notify-proxy hit header buffer/truncation -> PD signature/header mismatch -> retries triggered -> incident-bot retry loop (no idempotency key) -> flood. Mitigations: 1) reduce incident-bot retries to 1, 2) add idempotency key to payloads, 3) increase proxy header buffers, 4) roll back header signing change. I'm opening a rollback + fix PR now.
maria (sre): Agreed. I'll also add a safety throttle in the bot for duplicate-request suppression for the next deploy.
incident-bot: INFO suspend applied. Pending manual resume after verification.
jamal (oncall): Manual handoff note: paged infra-oncall and escalation to oncall-leads. No further missed pages observed after manual page.
lisa (support): I've notified AE and sent interim customer message: "We're aware of paging delays; manual paging in place; root cause being investigated."
alex (infra): Created PR #2012: "notifier: add idempotency-key + reduce retries" and PR #2013: "nginx: increase large_client_header_buffers for notify-proxy". Will ship rollback for header signing immediately.
maria (sre): Monitoring. If counts normalize in next 30m we'll transition to postmortem. I'll start the incident doc and add timeline + impact.
jamal (oncall): Thanks everyone. Logged manual steps in the incident doc.
alex (infra): Followups: add end-to-end tests for PD header size and add alert that triggers if retry_rate > 20/min.
maria (sre): :thumbsup: closing loop — alerting thresholds updated.
incident-bot: INFO resume blocked until manual approval.
alex (infra): moving to retro. Will attach logs and PD delivery receipts to the incident doc.
maria (sre): Closing here for now, will postpostmortem in #postmortems when ready.
